page_title: PAU 3-1 HOL | St. Pauli v Holstein Kiel 29/11/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+4' The referee blows his whistle for the final time to end this match.
90+4' The linesman points to the corner flag, Holstein Kiel are going to take it.
90+4' Armin Gigovic (Holstein Kiel) misses a great chance to score after his effort hits the right post!
90+2' Patrick Erras (Holstein Kiel) has to be very careful for the rest of the match after receiving a yellow card from the referee for a bad tackle on an opponent.
90+1' 3 - 1 What a beauty from just outside the box! Phil Harres (Holstein Kiel) lashed the ball with incredible pace and power into the bottom left corner.
90' 3 additional min. will be played.
90' Alexander Blessin has decided to make a change. Erik Ahlstrand (St. Pauli) replaces Oladapo Afolayan.
89' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Andreas Nielsen Albers (St. Pauli) is coming onto the pitch as Johannes Eggestein cannot continue after picking up an injury.
86' Oladapo Afolayan (St. Pauli) infringed the rules and goes into the book. Felix Zwayer pulls out a yellow card.
85' 3 - 0 Goal! Johannes Eggestein (St. Pauli) finds himself some space inside the box to get on the end of a pass from Philipp Treu, then sends the ball inside the left post. 3:0.

80' Timo Becker (Holstein Kiel) carelessly slides into the feet of his opponent and he'll be lucky to avoid punishment. Felix Zwayer blows for the foul but keeps his cards in his pocket on this occasion.
78' The attendance is 29546.
77' Here comes a substitution. Finn Porath is given a rest as he is replaced by Lasse Rosenboom (Holstein Kiel).
77' Here is a change. Magnus Knudsen is going off and Marcel Rapp gives the last tactical orders to Armin Gigovic (Holstein Kiel).
74' Alexander Blessin is forced to make a change. Morgan Guilavogui is not able to carry on due to injury. He is replaced by Danel Sinani (St. Pauli).
72' Morgan Guilavogui (St. Pauli) is down injured and the referee stops play so that he can receive medical treatment.
71' Here comes a substitution. Lars Ritzka (St. Pauli) is brought on as a substitute for Manolis Saliakas.
68' Marcel Rapp has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Tymoteusz Puchacz (Holstein Kiel) replacing Max Geschwill.
68' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Benedikt Pichler (Holstein Kiel) comes onto the pitch so that Lewis Holtby can be given a rest.

67' Lewis Holtby (Holstein Kiel) will take a long-range free kick and all of his teammates who are good in the air are already waiting on the edge of the penalty box for a cross to be sent in to them.
67' Lewis Holtby plays a lofted pass into the six-yard box. Phil Harres (Holstein Kiel) gets his head on the ball but balloons it high over the bar.
66' The Holstein Kiel players are exchanging short passes in an attempt to create a shooting opportunity.
63' Eric Smith (St. Pauli) swings in a dangerous cross from the resulting corner kick, but none of his teammates manage to outjump the defence.
62' Eric Smith (St. Pauli) looks like he will be the one to try and deliver a quality ball into the penalty box from the corner kick.
59' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Shuto Machino (Holstein Kiel) comes onto the pitch for Jann-Fiete Arp.

56' 2 - 0 Superb finishing from Morgan Guilavogui (St. Pauli). Johannes Eggestein plays a fantastic through ball and finds Morgan Guilavogui (St. Pauli), who reacts quickly to get in front of the goal and fire a close-range shot past the goalkeeper. It's 2:0.
54' Phil Harres (Holstein Kiel) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him.
49' The foul by Timo Becker (Holstein Kiel) was seen by Felix Zwayer who didn't hesitate to blow the whistle.
48' Nothing comes of the resulting corner from Jann-Fiete Arp (Holstein Kiel). The defence is alert and manages to cut it out.

47' Jann-Fiete Arp (Holstein Kiel) takes the corner, but one of the defenders reacts well and rises highest to head the ball away. The ball goes behind for a corner. Holstein Kiel will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
46' The players are back out on the pitch following the half-time break and the second half is about to start.
45+5' Felix Zwayer blows his whistle to signal the end of the first-half action.
45+4' St. Pauli are awarded a free kick near the side line and the players make their way into the box for the inevitable cross.
45' There will be a minimum of 3 min. of added time.
45' Jann-Fiete Arp (Holstein Kiel) blows a huge chance to score! He sends the penalty to the left side of the goal, but it's not enough to beat Nikola Vasilj who easily stops the effort.
45' Jann-Fiete Arp (Holstein Kiel) is heading towards the penalty spot to take it.
44' Felix Zwayer blows his whistle and signals a foul after Nikola Vasilj (St. Pauli) brought his opponent down. PENALTY! One of the players from Holstein Kiel is about to take a penalty kick.
38' Timo Becker (Holstein Kiel) goes into the referee's book. Yellow card.
38' The referee Felix Zwayer awards Eric Smith (St. Pauli) a yellow card.
38' Here comes the ref’s decision after the VAR review. It’s not penalty as the referee indicates there was no infringement.
38' Referee Felix Zwayer makes the VAR signal and is going to check whether it’s a penalty. Let’s see what happens!
37' Good work from St. Pauli as they win a corner.
37' CHANCE! Carlo Boukhalfa (St. Pauli) rises high to meet the resultant corner kick and attempts to steer his fine header past the goalkeeper, but only hits the crossbar!
36' Eric Smith (St. Pauli) goes over to take the corner kick and it looks like he will send the ball into the penalty box.
35' It will be a corner kick for Holstein Kiel.
32' Holstein Kiel have a goal-scoring opportunity from a mid-range free kick.
30' The shots on goal statistics – 1:0.
29' Morgan Guilavogui (St. Pauli) is first to the rebound but his shot is blocked. Wow, what an escape there for the opposition.
27' Marko Ivezic (Holstein Kiel) shouldn't be surprised it's a yellow from the ref, who cooled the situation down well.

25' 1 - 0 Manolis Saliakas (St. Pauli) controls the ball on the edge of the box after a superb low pass by Johannes Eggestein. He makes a yard for himself and fires a wonderful strike into the bottom left corner via the post. 1:0!
23' Shuto Machino (Holstein Kiel) gets a yellow card, off the field.
23' What was Lewis Holtby (Holstein Kiel) thinking? He will not get away with that. The referee shows him a yellow card.
19' Philipp Treu (St. Pauli) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence clears the ball away to eliminate the danger.
16' The St. Pauli players are exchanging some short passes.
13' Another attempt to send the ball beyond the defence by Magnus Knudsen (Holstein Kiel) is thwarted and cleared to safety.
10' A decent cross into the box is met first time by Manolis Saliakas (St. Pauli), but his powerful goalbound effort is superbly blocked by a defender.
9' Oladapo Afolayan (St. Pauli) has picked up a minor injury, but it looks like he will be able to continue.
8' The game is interrupted now, Oladapo Afolayan (St. Pauli) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.
6' Nicolai Remberg (Holstein Kiel) rushes a shot from long range and subsequently sends it high over the bar.
4' Jann-Fiete Arp (Holstein Kiel) tackles a bit over-zealously and Felix Zwayer blows for a foul.
